source_pages: printed p.53-54 / PDF 55-56 (subset extracted: the three straight sink bases)
extraction_note: Opened on demand for 7612 Hillside Dr, 2026-09-28: the sink side of the Tangram island. Extracted: sink base with door (p.53), with doors and with jumbo drawers (p.54). NOT extracted: the two corner sink bases on p.54 (AQ/AS096-126, AL1171/AL1181) - corner units need M2.2 placement, as at H.78. Prices not held here. Family keys (plinth, door versions, depths) are declared once, in base_h84.json; this file declares only the height, so the last-file-wins merge cannot take them away.
page_observations: NO HOB GLYPH on p.53 or p.54 at either depth - the third sink section to say so (H.58.5, H.78, H.84).
EVERY STRAIGHT POSITION CARRIES THE HUNG GLYPH at d.62 and d.67, plus the margin surcharge.
No d.35 sink base and no single-jumbo-drawer sink base at H.84 (H.78 prints B80681 / B90681); the explicit rows are the authority.
Suffix 69 for the two-jumbo-drawer sink base at H.84 where H.78 prints 87 - read off this page, not decoded.

sink_base_door.description: Sink base unit with door - 1 rh or lh door, 1 aluminium tray
sink_base_door.notes: Elevation printed p.53: 84 / 81 (handle / gola), one full-height door. The aluminium tray is stated by the source but is interior - recorded, not drawn.

front_layout.note: One door covering the full front, as for the plain base unit.

sink_base_door.wall_hung_note: SWEPT 2026-09-28 on the 150-dpi render of printed p.53 / p.54: the 'Hung version' glyph (legend printed p.19) is printed beside d.62 and d.67, and the margin carries 'Surch. for wall-hung version on page 548'. No hob flame on either band.

sink_base_jumbo_drawers.notes: Servo Drive referenced on the page as an option (p.567). LEGRABOX surcharges printed in the margin (stainless steel 215, ash/brown blumotion push-pull 65, stainless steel blumotion push-pull 280) - an order axis, not held here. No W600 row; smallest is W750.

front_layout.gola_note: 33 + 45 = 78 of fronts; the two 30 mm zones are carried from H.78 as for the drawer stack - an inference, not printed.
